Rees on Dogwood | Seagrove Beach

189 Dogwood Street, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459

Rees on Dogwood | 189 Dogwood Street is the newest luxury vacation rental to join the Rees portfolio in Seagrove Beach, Florida, along scenic 30A. Nestled beneath the iconic old oak trees that define Old Seagrove Beach, this thoughtfully curated 6 bedroom, 8 ½ bathroom retreat comfortably accommodates up to 18 guests. Designed for unforgettable gatherings with family and friends, the home features a private heated pool, sauna, cold plunge, and an unbeatable location just steps from Seaside and within walking distance of The Surfing Deer.

Beautifully designed by Katie Grace Designs, the home’s attention to detail is evident from the moment you step inside. The open-concept first floor was designed with both luxury and comfort in mind, making it ideal for multi-generational families or large groups seeking a one-of-a-kind 30A experience. The spacious living room flows seamlessly into the dining area and chef’s kitchen, creating the perfect space to gather and entertain. This level also includes a media room, laundry room, and a wellness space complete with a sauna and cold plunge.

The first-floor primary suite offers a true retreat, featuring a king-size bed and a spa-inspired private bathroom with an oversized shower and soaking tub. Outdoors, guests can enjoy the home year-round with covered lounge areas, an outdoor kitchen, fireplace, and a private heated pool designed for relaxation and entertaining alike.

The second floor features three beautifully appointed guest suites, each offering a king-size bed and private en-suite bathroom for added comfort and privacy.

The third floor is designed as the ultimate gathering space for younger guests, offering an elevated bunk-room experience, lounge area with television, and two additional bathrooms. Climb the spiral staircase to the observation deck, where sweeping views of Old Seagrove Beach and Seaside provide the perfect backdrop for sunrise coffee or evening cocktails.

Rees on Dogwood | 189 Dogwood is redefining the coastal luxury experience in Old Seagrove Beach. Whether you’re searching for a family vacation home to return to year after year or hosting loved ones for a wedding at the Seaside Chapel, this exceptional property offers a truly unforgettable stay and will quickly become your family’s home away from home.

**Construction Notice: the home next door is under construction; exterior appears to be 60% complete as of June 2026.

Pet Friendly: 40lb maximum. Extra cleaning fee of $250 applies . You must notify us of the breed and weight of dog

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Home Highlights:

Sleeps 18

Newly Designed - Summer 2026

6 Bedrooms + Bunk Room

8 1/2 Bathrooms

6,000 Square Feet

2 Minute Walk to Beach Access

Pet Friendly

Private Pool and Spa (can be heated for $65/day)

Wellness Space - Sauna and Cold Plunge Tub

Next to Seaside and Surfing Deer

Carriage House

2 Laundry Rooms

Parking for 5 Vehicles + Garage Access

6 Beach Cruiser Bicycles

First Floor

- Beautifully designed beach coastal decor and luxury furnishings

- High-end kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances including two dishwashers, 60’’ Wolf range, 60’’ Sub Zero refrigerator and freezer, pellet ice maker, and ample storage space

- Wet Bar with a built in beverage and wine refrigerator

- Dining table with seating for 12 guests and barstool seating at the kitchen island for 7 guests

- King master bedroom with a smart tv and ensuite featuring a double vanity, shower, and soaking tub

- Sand room and laundry room with plentiful beach towel storage

- Media room complete with full surround sound system

- Sauna and cold plunge tub

Second Floor

- Second king master bedroom with a smart tv, seating nook, and ensuite featuring a double vanity and shower

- Additional laundry room with two stackable washers and dryers

- Guest king bedroom with a smart tv and ensuite

- Guest king bedroom with a smart tv and ensuite

Third Floor

- Bunk room complete with four full beds and four twin beds

- Open lounge space complete with a smart tv, full surround sound and a large, cozy couch

- Two bathrooms for bunk room guests to share

Carriage House

- Modern kitchen and furnishings

- Living room

- King bedroom with a smart tv and ensuite bathroom

Outdoor Space

- Private pool and spa

- Outdoor shower and bathroom

- Outdoor living space

- Spacious driveway parking and garage access

- 6 Beach cruiser bicycles

Additional

- Nano doors in the living room are not available for guest usage. Please do not use, open, unlock, or tamper with the accordion doors. Additional fees may apply if damage or use of doors is found.

- The elevator is not for guest use. Please contact Dune Vacation Rentals for usage should someone in your party need access.

- Parking for 5 Vehicles.

- No events, such as wedding receptions and other large gatherings are allowed. Only people sleeping in the home are allowed on this property. If violated, double cleaning fees, as well as other possible fees, will apply.

- This home has a video/audio capturing doorbell mounted by the door and/or exterior cameras for safety.

Pool/Spa: This home may have a private pool and/or spa. Seasonal pool/spa heating is available upon request for $65/day plus tax. These cannot be heated separately as the water flows from the spa into the pool. If one is heated, they are both heated. The maximum temp for the pool is 90 degrees. Maximum temp for spa is 100 degrees. Pool and/or spa heat is not available during the warmer months from Memorial Day to September 30th.

Reservation/Booking Policy

- Minimum Age: All properties require a minimum of one adult over the age of 26 to be staying at the property throughout the rental term.

- A 50% deposit is due at the time of booking.

- Except for a $250 cancellation fee, deposits are fully refundable if cancellations are given 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Balance of payment is due 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Check-in begins at 4:00 PM and check-out is by 10:00 AM

- Mid-Stay Partial cleaning is required for stays of 5 to 13 nights.

- Mid-Stay Full cleaning is required for stays of 14 + nights
